(a) the dimensionality has a crucial influence on the stability of epitaxial ordered alloys, (b) the stability of ordered alloys against 2D surface segregation may be independent of their global stability and (c) the growth of epitaxial superlattices may proceed via a series of metastable states.

the stability of epitaxial ordered alloys depends on dimensionality of a given system, on atomic configuration of its surface and on the global stability of the 3-dimensional phase.

the dimensionality of a crystal has a crucial effect on the stability of ordered alloys.
